Then, I have another 3000 Euros that I want to convert into British Pounds, but this time, I want to use the last known exchange rate. After that, I have a distance of 100 kilometers that I want to convert into miles. Lastly, I have a weight of 75 kilograms that I want to convert into pounds. Can you do these conversions for me?"
